ja173:1.1: Father, this is a young brahmin,
ja173:1.2: reclining at a palm tree’s root,
ja173:1.3: Here there is a small hut, come now,
ja173:1.4: let us give the small hut to him.
ja173:2.1: Dearest, I do not reproach you,
ja173:2.2: (but) he would befoul our small hut,
ja173:2.3: A face of such a type was never a virtuous brahmin’s (face).
